fix(dropFirstBy, dropLast, dropWhile, takeWhile): support lazy evaluation (#1478)

Adding lazy evaluation support to additional functions. There was no
prior reason why lazy support wasn't added to them earlier, the lazy
implementation does not rely on any new mechanics added recently.

To accommodate for the lazy mechanics to match the eager ones we handle
non-integer `n` values for `dropFirstBy`, and `dropLast` explicitly via
rounding instead of implicitly.

Notice that if used in a `pipe` these utilities might behave differently
in regards to the order callbacks are called (`dropWhile`, `takeWhile`),
the shape of the 3rd `data` param (`dropWhile`, `takeWhile`), and the
impact on these things for other adjacent functions within the same
`pipe` with `takeWhile`.

---------
